proposed_rules.trigger: A thin full-width bar (~74px) at the very top of Solutions-category pages, above the hero, listing category tab labels (e.g. 'Solutions Business Need Work O...').
proposed_rules.decision: Model as a local secondary-navigation landmark (nav section) distinct from the global site nav; exclude the shared tab labels from the page's authorable body content. Rejected alternative: treat it as a plain content block (tab list) reproduced per page — that would duplicate shared chrome across every Solutions page instead of a single reusable nav fragment.
proposed_rules.rationale: Appears identically positioned on multiple Solutions sub-pages (white-label-apps, affiliates), indicating a shared category navigation component rather than page-specific content.
